'''Yarr Hinter''' was a [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], sent to [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] during the early days of the fledgling government.<ref name="WBC" /> Hinter was nearly assassinated<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|43|Hinter, Yarr}}</ref> by the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Londrah]] while on-planet, who had been hired by [[Gaen Drommel]].<ref name="WBC" />
